blocks.text: Step-by-step hal (solutions) banana hamein masle munazzam (organized) tareeqe se hal karne mein madad deta hai. In steps ko algorithms kehte hain. Har step saaf aur follow karne mein aasan hona chahiye. Steps sahi tarteeb (correct order) mein hone chahiyein. Is se masla hal karte waqt ghaltiyan nahi hotin. Koi bhi in steps ko aasani se samajh aur istemal kar sakta hai. Computer bhi step-by-step instructions (hidayat) par chalte hain (Figure 2.2 dekhein). Achhi planning sahi nateeje deti hai.

blocks.alt: Step-by-Step Algorithm Example ki heading ke neeche flowchart: Start, Boil Water (pani ubalein), Steep Tea (patti bhigoyein), Add Milk or Lemon (doodh ya lemon dalein), Serve Tea (chai pesh karein), End, teeron se jure. Saath mein ketli, tea bag wala cup, doodh, cheeni aur lemon, aur lemon wala cup.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.2: Qadam ba qadam algorithm ki misal (kitab ki Figure 2.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure 2.2 chai banane ka algorithm hai: Start, pani ubalein (Boil Water), patti dalein (Steep Tea), doodh ya lemon dalein, chai pesh karein (Serve Tea), End. Har step ek hi baar aur sahi tarteeb mein aata hai. Agar tarteeb badal dein (maslan pehle chai pesh karein, phir pani ubalein) to nateeja ghalat hoga. Yahi baat text kehta hai: sahi tarteeb ghaltiyan rokti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Achhe algorithm ki teen nishaniyan: (1) har step saaf aur aasan ho, (2) steps sahi tarteeb mein hon, (3) koi bhi (insaan ya computer) inhein follow kar ke wahi sahi nateeja hasil kare.

blocks.prompt: Subah school ke liye tayyar hone ka 4 se 5 steps ka algorithm likhein.
blocks.explanation: Misal (school ke liye tayyar hona): 1. Uthein aur muh haath dhoyein. 2. Uniform pehnein. 3. Nashta karein. 4. Bag aur lunch uthayein. 5. Ghar se niklein. Har step saaf hai aur tarteeb sahi hai; tarteeb badalne se (maslan pehle ghar se niklein) kaam ghalat ho jata hai.

items: Har step saaf aur aasan; steps sahi tarteeb mein; is se ghaltiyan rukti hain.
Computer bhi step-by-step instructions follow karte hain (Figure 2.2, chai ka algorithm).
